questions.q: If BRIDGE is written as GIFKTD in a certain code, how is WINTER written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 2 places forward and the word is then reversed: WINTER → TGVPKY. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: What comes next in the series? 5, 9, 17, 33, 65, …
questions.why: Each term is ×2 − 1. Next: 129. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 27, 38, 46, 60, 71, 82, 93
questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 11, so 46 should be 49. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: One morning just after sunrise, Vikram stood facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell exactly to his right. Which direction was he facing?
questions.why: After sunrise shadows fall to the west. If west is to his right, he is facing south.

questions.q: Pooja is the son of Lata. Ajay is the daughter of Lata. Sita is the husband of Ajay. How is Sita related to Pooja?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.
